journal_articles.title: The Art of Slow Brewing: Why Temperature and Patience Matter
journal_articles.author: Kindleaf Herbalist
journal_articles.excerpt: Most people brew green tea with boiling water and wonder why it tastes harsh. Learn the science of gentle heat and why 85°C produces liquid gold.
content: When hot water meets delicate whole-leaf green tea and botanicals, extraction begins within seconds. Standard commercial habits encourage pouring rolling boiling water (100°C) straight into a mug. However, at boiling point, bitter catechins and tannins rush out before sweet, delicate amino acids like L-theanine can balance the cup.
By keeping water temperature around 85°C—marked visually by small, energetic bubbles gathering at the bottom of the kettle—the green tea leaves unfurl gracefully without scorching.
Equally essential is steeping time. Allowing 3 to 5 minutes covered traps the natural aroma and volatile compounds from lemongrass and holy basil that would otherwise evaporate into thin air.
The result is a translucent amber-green infusion that carries bright citrus notes upfront, followed by an aromatic herbal middle and a comforting ginger warmth.
journal_articles.seo_title: The Art of Slow Brewing Green Tea | Kindleaf Journal
journal_articles.seo_description: Learn how brewing green tea at 85°C preserves delicate L-theanine and essential aromas without bitterness.

journal_articles.title: Tulsi & Lemongrass: Botanical Aromas in Ancient and Modern Tea Traditions
journal_articles.author: Kindleaf Herbalist
journal_articles.excerpt: Exploring the centuries-old presence of Holy Basil (Tulsi) in Indian households and how crisp lemongrass elevates traditional green tea.
content: In traditional Indian homes, Holy Basil (Ocimum tenuiflorum, commonly known as Tulsi) has held a cherished place in courtyard gardens for centuries. Known for its distinctively aromatic, peppery scent, Tulsi was traditionally plucked fresh and steeped into warm water during quiet dawn rituals.

When paired with lemongrass (Cymbopogon citratus), a fascinating sensory transition occurs. Lemongrass carries citral, which introduces a sparkling, clean citrus top note. This cuts through the astringency of traditional green tea and softens the herbal depth of Tulsi.

At Kindleaf, we hand-blend whole cut leaves rather than pulverizing them into dusty tea-bag powder. Whole botanicals retain their natural cell structures and fragrant oils until the moment hot water activates them in your cup.
journal_articles.seo_description: Discover how Holy Basil and fresh Lemongrass harmonize with green tea for an uplifting, mindful aroma.

journal_articles.title: Mindful Tea Rituals: Reclaiming Ten Quiet Minutes in a Noisy Day
journal_articles.author: Gaurav Singh
journal_articles.excerpt: A simple cup of tea can become an anchor in your day. Here is how to turn preparation into an intentional, grounding pause.
content: We live in a world of constant pings, urgent notifications, and back-to-back demands. We frequently reach for caffeinated beverages while rushing between tasks, barely noticing what we are drinking.
A daily tea ritual is not about elaborate ceremonies or rigid rules. It is simply an agreement with yourself to pause for ten minutes.
Notice the visual unfurling of the leaves. Feel the comforting weight and warmth of the cup in both hands. Take three deliberate nasal breaths before the first sip.
These brief sensory anchors remind our nervous systems that between every demand, there is space to pause and restore calm.
journal_articles.seo_title: Mindful Tea Rituals: 10 Quiet Minutes | Kindleaf
journal_articles.seo_description: Reclaim stillness in a busy day with a simple 10-minute tea ritual.

journal_articles.title: From a Soldier’s Home to Your Cup: The Kindleaf Journey
journal_articles.author: Gaurav Singh
journal_articles.excerpt: How honest values, discipline, and a deep respect for natural ingredients shaped Kindleaf in Jasrana, Uttar Pradesh.
content: Kindleaf was founded by Gaurav Singh, raised in a proud soldier’s family in Jasrana, Firozabad, Uttar Pradesh. In a home shaped by military discipline, honesty and accountability were foundational values.
When looking at the modern wellness market, it was frustrating to see shelves dominated by mass-produced teas sprayed with artificial flavoring agents and marketed with dubious miracle claims.
Kindleaf was created with a clear golden rule: 'If you can’t consume your own product every single day, you have no business selling it to others.'
From selecting green tea base, fragrant Holy Basil, crisp lemongrass, to real dried ginger root, every batch is prepared with pride, transparency, and care.

faqs.question: What is Kindleaf?
faqs.answer: Kindleaf is an artisanal Indian herbal tea brand. Founded by Gaurav Singh from a soldier's family in Jasrana, Uttar Pradesh, we craft 100% natural herbal green tea blends designed for mindful daily tea rituals.

faqs.question: What ingredients are used in the blend?
faqs.answer: Kindleaf contains exactly four natural botanicals: Green Tea Leaves (Camellia sinensis), Holy Basil / Tulsi (Ocimum tenuiflorum), Lemongrass (Cymbopogon citratus), and Dried Ginger Root (Zingiber officinale). There are no artificial flavours, sprays, or preservatives.

faqs.question: How should Kindleaf be brewed for optimal flavour?
faqs.answer: Heat fresh water to approximately 85°C (bubbles forming gently, not a violent rolling boil). Add 1 teaspoon (about 2 grams) to your cup or infuser, pour the water, and steep covered for 3 to 5 minutes. Strain and sip mindfully.

faqs.question: What does the blend taste like?
faqs.answer: The blend offers a balanced, smooth flavour profile: fresh, crisp green tea with an uplifting citrus aroma from lemongrass, a fragrant peppery middle from Holy Basil, and a comforting warm finish from dry ginger.

faqs.question: Where can I purchase Kindleaf?
faqs.answer: To ensure direct freshness and direct small-batch packaging, Kindleaf products are ordered exclusively through the official Kindleaf Mobile App for Android and iOS. This website is purely educational and does not process payments or orders directly.

faqs.question: How does the Kindleaf App work?
faqs.answer: The Kindleaf Mobile App allows you to order fresh batches directly, track small-batch dispatch in real time, access daily guided tea mindfulness timers, and receive notifications when limited seasonal harvests become available.

faqs.question: Does Kindleaf contain caffeine?
faqs.answer: Yes, because the base of our blend is natural Camellia sinensis (green tea leaves), it naturally contains a mild amount of caffeine (typically 20-30mg per cup, roughly one-third of a cup of coffee). It is paired with calming herbs like Tulsi for a steady, jitter-free tea moment.

faqs.question: What is the shelf life and how should it be stored?
faqs.answer: Kindleaf tea retains its optimal aromatic freshness for 12 months from the packaging date. Keep the pouch tightly sealed in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, moisture, and strong spices.

brewing_guide.title: The Art of Mindful Steeping
brewing_guide.intro: Steeping tea is not merely waiting; it is an intentional ritual of presence. Follow these four simple steps to unlock the full botanical synergy of Green Tea, Tulsi, Lemongrass, and Ginger.
brewing_guide.tips: Covering your cup while steeping traps volatile botanical aromas that would otherwise escape.

steps.title: Heat Water to ~85°C
steps.summary: Bring fresh water to a gentle bubble, not a violent rolling boil. Overly hot water scorches delicate green tea leaves, masking subtle citrus and floral notes.

steps.title: Measure 1 Teaspoon (~2g)
steps.summary: Place one teaspoon of whole cut Kindleaf botanicals into your strainer or favorite infuser mug.

steps.title: Steep Covered for 3–5 Mins
steps.summary: Pour hot water and cover immediately. Covering traps the precious natural aromas of holy basil and lemongrass inside your cup.

steps.title: Strain, Inhale & Sip Mindfully
steps.summary: Remove leaves. Pause and feel the warmth of the ceramic cup. Inhale the steam, take your first gentle sip, and restore calm.

our_story.heading: A Small Dream from a Soldier’s Home
our_story.story_p1: Kindleaf did not begin in a corporate boardroom or an industrial processing plant. It was born right at home in Jasrana, Firozabad, Uttar Pradesh, founded by Gaurav Singh, coming from a proud soldier’s family.
our_story.story_p2: Growing up in a home anchored in discipline and integrity, honesty was non-negotiable. When observing the commercial tea industry, it was clear that many shelves were filled with artificial flavorings, synthetic sprays, and hollow marketing promises.
our_story.story_p3: Kindleaf was created with an unwavering commitment: craft a tea blend that is 100% natural, using pure whole green tea leaves, aromatic holy basil (Tulsi), zesty lemongrass, and warming dried ginger. Each batch is blended and packaged in small quantities with meticulous care.
our_story.founder_quote: I strongly believe in one principle: If you can’t consume your own product every day, you probably shouldn’t be selling it. At Kindleaf, we drink the exact same tea we ship to you.
